question: How many active employees are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE employee_status = 'active' AND is_payroll = true;

question: How many civil engineers work in Moscow?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE role = 'Civil Engineer' AND city = 'Moscow';

question: List all employees in the Engineering department.
sql: SELECT e.full_name, e.role FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Engineering';

question: How many contractors are currently active?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE is_payroll = false AND employee_status = 'active';

question: Which employees work on the GPP project?
sql: SELECT e.full_name FROM employees_clean e JOIN project_assignments pa ON e.employee_id = pa.employee_id JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.project_code = 'GPP';

question: How many employees are in each department?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: How many terminated employees were in the HR department?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Human Resources' AND e.employee_status = 'terminated';

question: List all project managers who are active payroll employees.
sql: SELECT full_name FROM employees_clean WHERE role = 'Project Manager' AND is_payroll = true AND employee_status = 'active';

question: How many employees were hired in 2023?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) = 2023;

question: Which city has the most active employees?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees_clean WHERE employee_status = 'active' GROUP BY city ORDER BY employee_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many software engineers are assigned to more than one project?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT e.employee_id FROM employees_clean e JOIN project_assignments pa ON e.employee_id = pa.employee_id WHERE e.role = 'Software Engineer' GROUP BY e.employee_id HAVING COUNT(pa.project_id) > 1) sub;

question: List employees who are not assigned to any project.
sql: SELECT e.full_name FROM employees_clean e LEFT JOIN project_assignments pa ON e.employee_id = pa.employee_id WHERE pa.employee_id IS NULL;

question: How many data analysts work in Istanbul?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE role = 'Data Analyst' AND city = 'Istanbul';

question: Which department has the most contractors?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS contractor_count FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.is_payroll = false GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY contractor_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many employees work on the Skyline Tower project?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_assignments pa JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.project_name = 'Skyline Tower';

question: List all accountants who are active.
sql: SELECT full_name, city FROM employees_clean WHERE role = 'Accountant' AND employee_status = 'active';

question: How many employees were hired before 2020?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE hire_date < '2020-01-01';

question: What is the total number of employees assigned to each project?
sql: SELECT p.project_name, COUNT(*) AS assigned_employees FROM project_assignments pa JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.project_name;

question: List HR analysts who are contractors.
sql: SELECT full_name FROM employees_clean WHERE role = 'HR Analyst' AND is_payroll = false;

question: How many active employees work in London or Berlin?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE employee_status = 'active' AND city IN ('London', 'Berlin');

question: Which employees are assigned to both the GPP and Cloud Migration projects?
sql: SELECT e.full_name FROM employees_clean e JOIN project_assignments pa1 ON e.employee_id = pa1.employee_id JOIN projects p1 ON pa1.project_id = p1.project_id JOIN project_assignments pa2 ON e.employee_id = pa2.employee_id JOIN projects p2 ON pa2.project_id = p2.project_id WHERE p1.project_code = 'GPP' AND p2.project_name = 'Cloud Migration';

question: How many employees does the IT department have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'IT';

question: List the 10 most recently hired employees.
sql: SELECT full_name, hire_date FROM employees_clean ORDER BY hire_date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many project managers work in Dubai?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees_clean WHERE role = 'Project Manager' AND city = 'Dubai';

question: Which projects have no employees assigned to them?
sql: SELECT p.project_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN project_assignments pa ON p.project_id = pa.project_id WHERE pa.project_id IS NULL;

question: How many employees are terminated in each department?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS terminated_count FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.employee_status = 'terminated' GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: List all employees hired in the Finance department after 2021.
sql: SELECT e.full_name, e.hire_date FROM employees_clean e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Finance' AND e.hire_date > '2021-01-01';

question: How many employees work on more than one project?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT employee_id FROM project_assignments GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(project_id) > 1) sub;

question: Which city has the most contractors?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS contractor_count FROM employees_clean WHERE is_payroll = false GROUP BY city ORDER BY contractor_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List all active software engineers and the project they're assigned to.
sql: SELECT e.full_name, p.project_name FROM employees_clean e JOIN project_assignments pa ON e.employee_id = pa.employee_id JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE e.role = 'Software Engineer' AND e.employee_status = 'active';
